anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The Lord your God is a consuming fire.
Our God is a consuming fire.
Quoted sense: boiling in the Spirit.

choices.why: The same cooking field as roast/boil.

pass_a_gloss: And if the Spirit is given us from God, and God is a consuming fire, the Spirit itself is also fire, which the apostle knowing exhorts us boiling in the Spirit.
pass_b_english: And if the Spirit is given us from God, and God is a consuming fire, the Spirit itself is also fire — which the apostle, knowing, exhorts us to be boiling in the Spirit (Deuteronomy 4:24) (Hebrews 12:29) (Romans 12:11) (Acts 2:3–4).
source_text: Εἰ δὲ τὸ [πν(εῦμ)α ἀπὸ] τοῦ θ(εο)ῦ [δίδο]ται ἡμῖ[ν, ὁ δὲ θ(εὸ)ς] πῦρ κα[τα]να[λ]ί[σκ]ον ἐ[στί]ν, καὶ αὐτὸ τὸ πν(εῦμ)α πῦ[ρ] ἐστιν, ὅπερ ὁ ἀπόστολος ἐπιστάμενος προτρέπεται ἡμᾶς τῷ πν(εύματ)ι ζέοντας.
